assertions.text: PLAN.md file exists at the output path

assertions.evidence: ## Goal section present: 'Send an email notification to each user whose subscription expires exactly 7 days from now. The check should run automatically once per day (e.g. at 08:00).'

assertions.text: Plan contains a '## Files' section listing specific file paths (not just vague module names)

assertions.text: Plan contains at least 3 numbered implementation steps

assertions.text: At least one step references a specific file name or function name
